practical_assessment.reason: Notebook describes functions and claimed results, but does not include the V152 anchor artifacts, large prebuilt feature matrices, or a complete executable feature build.
practical_assessment.public_benchmark: Slightly better than current local-log best public ID178 0.6014113009, but still far from public 0.55 and still has a large local-public gap.

transferable_ideas: Use conservative anchor blending rather than high-variance residual dominance.
Compare subject-hole and within-subject temporal validation lenses before trusting local CV.
Prefer stability-selected features and low-variance models for leaderboard-facing candidates.
Rank candidates by public-gap risk signals: prediction extremeness, anchor distance, and target-wise drift.
